Element.Description: Weapon type used to select the target's damage response. The Unstoppable type also marks this damage as an instant kill.
Base damage before the target's Damage Multiplier is applied.
Radius used for distance-based knockback falloff. Loading this record does not enable radius damage by itself.
Base knockback strength before distance falloff and the target's damage response are applied. Damage Radius supplies the falloff distance.
